description: This file defines the NavbarComponent in an Angular application, handling user authentication state and providing a logout method.

classes.name: NavbarComponent
classes.description: An Angular component responsible for rendering the navigation bar with login status and logout functionality.

methods.description: Initializes the component, subscribing to the authentication status observable.
